freeTier.summary: No free plan. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial; after that the cheapest option is Starter at $97/month.

trial.summary: 14-day free trial on Starter, Unlimited or Agency Pro with full access to the chosen tier. The pricing page says billing begins automatically at the end of the trial unless canceled, and that usage-based telecom or third-party fees may be charged during the trial. Whether a card is taken up front was not captured (the signup form's 'Trial Details' step was not reached).

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: $970 billed yearly ($80.83/mo). HighLevel's FAQ also calls it 'Agency Starter' and describes it as 'perfect for a single business owner or a new agency'. Users are unlimited, so there is no per-seat charge.
limits: Cannot rebill phone, email or AI usage to sub-accounts (rebilling starts on the $297 plan)
Dedicated email IPs not available (Unlimited and Agency Pro only)
Basic API access only (location-level API keys)
highlights: All core features: CRM and pipelines, website and funnel builder, workflows, calendars, forms, email and SMS marketing, reputation management, courses, communities, payments and invoicing

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.note: $2,970 billed yearly ($247.50/mo). Marketed as 'built for growing agencies'.
limits: Usage can be rebilled to sub-accounts at cost only; HighLevel's terms forbid marking up pass-through fees below the $497 plan (phone and email rebilling default to a fixed 1.05x to cover Stripe fees)
AI Employee rebilling requires Agency Pro
highlights: Rebill phone and email usage to clients (no markup)
Eligible for dedicated email IPs ($59/month each)

plans.name: Agency Pro
plans.note: $4,970 billed yearly ($414.17/mo). HighLevel's help articles also call it the '$497 SaaS plan'.
highlights: SaaS Mode: sell HighLevel as your own subscription product with automated sub-account creation
Rebill phone, email, AI and other usage with your own markup
Advanced API access (agency API keys, OAuth)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Quote only via HighLevel's enterprise team; no public price.
highlights: Full feature set of the highest platform plan
Premium Support, White Label Mobile App and HIPAA compliance included in purchase
Dedicated customer success and account manager, dedicated Slack channel, quarterly business reviews

addOns.name: AI Employee Growth plan
addOns.note: Includes 1,000 Conversation AI agent responses and 100 Voice AI minutes a month, unlimited Reviews AI and Content AI; overage billed at pay-per-use rates. Phone System charges still apply to calls.

addOns.name: AI Employee Unlimited plan
addOns.note: Unlimited Conversation AI, Voice AI, Reviews AI and Content AI subject to fair use; Agent Studio is still pay-per-use and Phone System charges still apply to calls.

addOns.name: Dedicated email IP
addOns.note: Only available on the $297 and $497 plans. HighLevel advises sending at least 50,000 emails a week on a dedicated IP.

addOns.name: Workflow Pro (Starter tier)
addOns.unit: per sub-account per month, 10,000 premium workflow executions included
addOns.note: Execution allowances are per sub-account. Overage $0.008 per execution. Growth tier $25/mo (30,000 executions, $0.006 overage); Scale tier $50/mo (65,000 executions, $0.004 overage). Does not cover ChatGPT or Workflow AI executions.

addOns.name: HIPAA compliance
addOns.note: Available on any plan. Once purchased and enabled it cannot be deactivated.

addOns.name: Online listings management
addOns.note: Also $150 per 6 months or $300 per year. HighLevel's billing FAQ says a 3-month commitment applies.

addOns.name: WordPress hosting (Standard)
addOns.note: $108/yr. Utility plan $220/mo for 25 sites; Truly Unlimited $497/mo.

addOns.name: Pause Plan (keep data instead of canceling)
addOns.note: Mentioned in HighLevel's billing FAQ as the way to keep data (canceled accounts are deleted after 90 days); the same article also says agency accounts cannot be paused.

usage.name: Local phone number (LC Phone)
usage.unit: per US/Canada local number per month

usage.name: Toll-free phone number (LC Phone)
usage.unit: per US/Canada toll-free number per month

usage.name: SMS
usage.unit: per SMS segment, outbound or inbound (US/Canada)
usage.note: 10% below the $0.0083 list price. Inbound texts are charged at the same rate. Charged on every delivery attempt; no refunds for undelivered SMS.

usage.name: SMS carrier fee (T-Mobile or Verizon, outbound)
usage.unit: per outbound SMS segment, on top of the SMS rate
usage.note: Varies by recipient carrier: AT&T $0.0035, US Cellular $0.0050, all other carriers $0.0040. Inbound carrier fees run $0.0025 to $0.0100.

usage.name: MMS, outbound (US/Canada)
usage.note: Inbound MMS $0.0165 (local number) or $0.0200 (toll-free), plus carrier fees.

usage.name: A2P 10DLC monthly campaign fee (Low Volume Mixed)
usage.note: Required to text US numbers from local numbers. Standard campaign use cases cost $10.00/month; Sole Proprietor $2.00/month. Low Volume Mixed allows up to 2,000 segments/day to T-Mobile.

usage.name: Outbound call (US/Canada)
usage.note: $0.0126 carrier leg + $0.004 client minutes. Calls bill in full minutes (partials round up). Every outgoing call also runs as a conference call, adding conference charges.

usage.name: Inbound call answered in web, mobile app or desk phone (US/Canada)
usage.note: Forwarding to a US number costs $0.02/min; inbound to a toll-free number $0.0198/min.

usage.name: Conference call charge (US)
usage.note: HighLevel applies conference charges to all outgoing calls, not only transfers.

usage.name: Call recording
usage.note: Storage adds $0.0005 per stored minute per month for as long as recordings are kept.

usage.name: Email (LC Email)
usage.note: Applies on all plans. All incoming and outgoing emails (To, CC and BCC) and forwarded emails are charged.

usage.name: Premium workflow trigger/action (e.g. inbound webhook, custom webhook, Google Sheets, Slack)
usage.unit: per execution after 100 free lifetime executions per sub-account (not a monthly allowance)
usage.note: Standard workflow steps are free. The 100 free executions are a one-time lifetime allowance per sub-account. Premium Workflow AI actions (Decision Maker, Intent Detection, Summarize, Translate) are also $0.01/execution per HighLevel's AI Product Pricing article; GPT and other external-model actions bill at model rates.

usage.name: Conversation AI, pay-per-use (GPT-5 input tokens)
usage.note: Output tokens $10.00 per 1M. GPT-5 Mini is $0.25 in / $2.00 out. Applies to locations not on an AI Employee plan.

usage.name: Voice AI engine, pay-per-use
usage.note: Plus text-to-speech (OpenAI or Cartesia $0.015/min, ElevenLabs V3 $0.170/min), LLM tokens, and Phone System call charges.

usage.name: Voice AI speech-to-speech (Gemini live model)
usage.note: OpenAI gpt-realtime is $0.20/min. Phone System call charges still apply.

usage.name: WhatsApp marketing template message (US & Canada)
usage.note: As listed in HighLevel's table; its October 2026 CSV lists $0.0250 and the guide says a 5% payment-processing fee is added, which matches $0.0263.

usage.name: WhatsApp utility template message (US & Canada)
usage.note: Billable in and out of the 24-hour customer service window since 1 October 2026; until 30 September 2026 it was free inside an open window.

extraCosts.label: A2P 10DLC brand + first campaign registration
extraCosts.note: Sole Proprietor or Low Volume Standard brand, includes the $3 Fast Track fee. High Volume Standard is $64.00. Charged when the campaign is submitted, whatever the review outcome.

extraCosts.label: Additional A2P campaign vetting
extraCosts.note: Resubmitting a rejected campaign is free.

extraCosts.label: 5% markup on phone pass-through charges
extraCosts.display: +5% on A2P fees, SMS/MMS carrier fees, Verified Caller ID and RCS carrier fees
extraCosts.note: The 5% markup article says it applies 'regardless of whether agency rebilling is enabled', and the Phone System guide's key points say it 'always applies'; the same guide also says 'only when re-billing is enabled' and shows a no-rebilling example without it, and the A2P fee article says HighLevel adds no markup. The scenarios include it (5% of carrier fees and the A2P monthly fee) as the higher, more conservative reading.

extraCosts.label: WhatsApp payment processing fee
extraCosts.note: Stated in the WhatsApp pricing guide; the listed US rates appear to include it already.

extraCosts.label: Prepaid usage wallet with forced auto-recharge
extraCosts.display: Card charged whenever the wallet drops below its threshold
extraCosts.note: Usage (SMS, calls, email, AI, premium workflow steps) is prepaid from a wallet. Auto Recharge cannot be disabled; Smart Adjustment raises the recharge amount (e.g. $200 to $500) if it triggers more than three times in seven days unless you turn it off. The Terms cite a $10 threshold.

extraCosts.label: Advanced Account Setup (optional done-with-you setup)
extraCosts.note: Optional; not required to use the platform.

extraCosts.label: Unclaimed wallet balance after cancellation
extraCosts.display: Forfeited after 30 days unless you request a refund
extraCosts.note: Per the Terms, wallet funds left more than 30 days after cancellation become HighLevel's property; free promotional credits expire after 90 days.

extraCosts.label: Sales tax / VAT
extraCosts.display: Added on top of all fees
extraCosts.note: Fees exclude taxes; tax on wallet spending is calculated after each month and taken from the wallet balance.

billingNotes: Month-to-month with no long-term contract; cancel, upgrade or downgrade from the dashboard.
Annual billing is $970, $2,970 or $4,970 a year: 10 times the monthly price.
Upgrades are charged immediately with a prorated credit for the unused part of the old plan. Moving an existing yearly plan back to monthly requires contacting HighLevel.
The Terms say all fees are non-refundable (subscriptions, communication surcharges, resold third-party services) and subscriptions auto-renew at the then-current rates.
The plan price does not include messaging: SMS, calls, phone numbers, email, most AI, WhatsApp messages and premium workflow steps are billed separately from a prepaid wallet.

Starter cannot rebill usage to sub-accounts. Unlimited rebills at cost (default 1.05x to cover Stripe fees). Only Agency Pro may mark up pass-through fees, and only Agency Pro can rebill AI Employee usage.
You can connect your own SMTP provider instead of LC Email, and switch a location from LC Phone to your own Twilio account.
LC Email sending ramps up over the first 7 days (250 on day 1 to 10,000 on day 7), then allows 25,000 a day on a shared domain or up to 550,000 a day with a dedicated sending domain.
WhatsApp: since 1 October 2026, service messages beyond 1,000 per phone number per month and utility messages inside the 24-hour window are billable, and rates changed in several markets.
If a subscription payment fails, access continues for 21 days and is then locked. Canceled accounts' data is deleted after 90 days. Phone numbers are released within 14 days of cancellation.
HIPAA compliance cannot be canceled once enabled, and Online Listings has a 3-month commitment.

regional.note: Plan prices are published in USD and no country-specific plan prices were seen. Usage rates (phone numbers, SMS, calls, WhatsApp) vary by country; HighLevel's in-app Wallet Pricing page shows rates for 27 countries. All usage figures here are US rates. Taxes/VAT are added on top.

scenarios.label: Solo operator, 1,000 contacts, 200 texts a month
scenarios.assumptions: 1 user, 1,000 contacts, 2,000 marketing emails/mo and 200 outbound SMS/mo for one business location using HighLevel's built-in LC Phone and LC Email, billed month to month. One local number ($1.15). Each SMS is 1 segment (160 plain-text characters or fewer): 200 x $0.00747 = $1.494. Carrier fee assumed at $0.0045/segment (T-Mobile/Verizon outbound rate): 200 x $0.0045 = $0.90. A2P 10DLC Low Volume Mixed campaign $1.50/mo (the $22.50 one-time registration is not included). Email 2,000 x $0.675/1,000 = $1.35. Inbound texts and inbound emails are also billed but not counted. No AI Employee, no calls, no premium workflow steps beyond the 100 free executions. HighLevel's 5% location-level markup on pass-through charges is applied to the carrier fees and the A2P monthly fee (HighLevel's docs conflict on whether it applies without rebilling; see unverified).

lines.label: SMS carrier fees: 200 x $0.0045 (assumed carrier mix)
5% pass-through markup on carrier fees and A2P fee: ($0.90 + $1.50) x 5%

scenarios.note: Starter already covers this size: 3 sub-accounts, unlimited users and contacts. On annual billing the plan line drops to $80.83/mo. First month also carries the $22.50 A2P registration (plus 5% if the markup applies).

scenarios.label: Small team, 3 users, 5,000 contacts, 1,000 texts a month
scenarios.assumptions: 3 users, 5,000 contacts, 20,000 emails/mo and 1,000 outbound SMS/mo for one business location, billed month to month. One local number ($1.15). SMS 1,000 x $0.00747 = $7.47. Carrier fee assumed at $0.0045/segment: 1,000 x $0.0045 = $4.50. A2P 10DLC Low Volume Mixed campaign $1.50/mo. Email 20,000 x $0.675/1,000 = $13.50. Same exclusions as solo. HighLevel's 5% location-level markup on pass-through charges is applied to the carrier fees and the A2P monthly fee (HighLevel's docs conflict on whether it applies without rebilling; see unverified).

lines.label: SMS carrier fees: 1,000 x $0.0045 (assumed carrier mix)
5% pass-through markup on carrier fees and A2P fee: ($4.50 + $1.50) x 5%

scenarios.note: Still Starter. Users and contacts are unlimited on every plan and Starter's only hard cap is 3 sub-accounts; one business needs one. What Unlimited ($297) adds (unlimited sub-accounts, rebilling usage to clients, dedicated-IP eligibility) serves agencies, not a single business.

scenarios.label: Growing team, 8 users, 25,000 contacts, 5,000 texts a month
scenarios.assumptions: 8 users, 25,000 contacts, 100,000 emails/mo and 5,000 outbound SMS/mo for one business location, billed month to month. One local number ($1.15) and one A2P campaign. SMS 5,000 x $0.00747 = $37.35. Carrier fee assumed at $0.0045/segment: 5,000 x $0.0045 = $22.50. A2P 10DLC Low Volume Mixed campaign $1.50/mo (5,000 texts a month is well under its 2,000 segments/day T-Mobile limit). Email 100,000 x $0.675/1,000 = $67.50. Same exclusions as solo. HighLevel's 5% location-level markup on pass-through charges is applied to the carrier fees and the A2P monthly fee (HighLevel's docs conflict on whether it applies without rebilling; see unverified).

lines.label: SMS carrier fees: 5,000 x $0.0045 (assumed carrier mix)
5% pass-through markup on carrier fees and A2P fee: ($22.50 + $1.50) x 5%

scenarios.note: Still Starter: 8 users and 25,000 contacts sit inside Starter's unlimited users and contacts. 100,000 emails/mo is about 23,000 a week, under the 50,000/week HighLevel advises for a dedicated IP (which would force Unlimited). One send to all 25,000 contacts reaches the 25,000/day shared-domain cap in the LC Email article, and the same article's FAQ mentions a 15,000 limit for sub-accounts without their own dedicated domain; adding a dedicated sending domain to the location raises the cap (the setup article lists no fee). Each extra local number for the team is $1.15/mo. At this size usage is about $131 of the $228.20 bill, more than the plan itself.

unverified: Whether the 14-day trial requires a card up front: the signup form asks for business details first and its 'Trial Details' step was not reached. The pricing page says billing starts automatically when the trial ends unless canceled.

The 5% pass-through markup on A2P and carrier fees: the markup article (9 Sep 2026) says it applies whether or not rebilling is enabled and the Phone System guide (24 Sep 2026) says it 'always applies', but the same guide also says 'only when re-billing is enabled' and the A2P fee article says HighLevel adds no markup. The scenarios include it; without it they fall by $0.12 (solo), $0.30 (small) and $1.20 (growing).

The Phone System guide lists A2P monthly fees with the 5% built in (Sole Proprietor 'up to $2.10', Low Volume '$1.50-$10.50', High Volume '$10.50'), while the A2P article lists $2.00 / $1.50 / $10.00. The scenarios use the A2P article's $1.50.
Carrier fees depend on each recipient's carrier; the scenarios assume $0.0045 per outbound segment for every text.
Pay-per-use Conversation AI and Voice AI cost per conversation depends on token counts and cannot be priced in advance; only the per-token and per-minute rates are recorded.

The per-message price for US WhatsApp service messages beyond the free 1,000 a month (in force since 1 October 2026) appears only in an attached CSV ($0.0034 before the 5% fee), not in the guide's table.
HighLevel's pricing pages list no platform fee on payments taken through Stripe, PayPal, Square and other connected processors, but processor fees were not captured.
Domain purchase prices vary by TLD and were not captured.
Whether a dedicated email sending domain costs anything: the setup article lists no fee, but does not say it is free.
The $27/month Pause Plan is mentioned in HighLevel's billing FAQ, which also says agency accounts cannot be paused.
HighLevel's in-app Wallet Pricing page (the source it calls authoritative for usage rates) requires a login and was not captured.
